subclassFeature.name: Bloodtouched
entries: Your magic stems from a cursed bloodline or a forbidden ritual that altered your very essence.

subclassFeature.name: Bloodsign
entries: You learn bonus spells automatically based on your sorcerer level:

subclassFeature.name: Blood Tradition
entries: You gain proficiency in one of the following skills: {@skill History}, {@skill Religion}, or {@skill Arcana}. Additionally, your hit point maximum increases by 3, and increases by 1 whenever you gain a level in this class after level 3.

subclassFeature.name: Thirst for Blood
entries: Once per turn, when you kill one or more creatures that possess blood using a spell of 1st level or higher, you regain hit points equal to three times the spell's level.

subclassFeature.name: Superior Blood Tradition
entries: Starting at 6th level, you add your {@b Constitution} modifier to all saving throws you make.

subclassFeature.name: Overwhelming Power
entries: Your body can push past mortal limits. Once per turn, if you took the Attack action, you can deal {@damage 6} + your proficiency bonus + your {@b Constitution} modifier as a bonus action and take half of that damage yourself.
If you do so, you can make a second Attack action this turn. At 18th level, you can use this feature one additional time per turn (two times total).

subclassFeature.name: Master of Blood
entries: For 5 sorcery points or half your current hit points (as long as you have more than 20 HP), you control a corpse or unconscious creature within 30 feet. This creature shares your initiative and has its own action, bonus action, and reaction.
The creature regains hit points equal to your level × {@dice 1d4}. Upon death, its soul cannot be restored. While active, you gain the following benefits:

items: One-quarter of the hit points restored become temporary hit points for you.
You regain one spell slot of 4th level or lower.
